traceability.notes: The story docs/stories/003.0-DEV-FUNCTION-ANNOTATIONS.story.md defines coordinated ESLint rules require-story-annotation and require-req-annotation over a shared set of function-like constructs, with common JSDoc parsing, configurable scope/exportPriority, precise error locations, TypeScript support, robust error handling, and rule documentation. The current implementation meets all these requirements: DEFAULT_SCOPE and shouldProcessNode enforce the same function set for both rules, arrow functions are excluded by default, @story and @req are required and parsed via shared heuristic strategies, export priority and scope are fully configurable and documented, error locations are anchored at function names, and TSDeclareFunction/TSMethodSignature are supported and tested. Rule documentation for both rules is present and aligned with the story. Comprehensive tests explicitly tied to this story all pass (as verified by `npm test -- --verbose`). Therefore, all acceptance criteria of this story are satisfied in the current codebase.
